items.title: lantern.keys
items.subtitle: 9 hours ago | 64 likes
items.overview: Came for the ridge, stayed for the forty seconds of a kettle boiling. Nobody else films the waiting, and the waiting is most of a walk like this one. I timed it: eleven minutes of this film are somebody sitting still, and none of them is wasted. The cut from the stove to the first light on the east face is the quietest good edit I have seen all year. Please never add music.
items.author: lantern.keys
